format: SIPT Dynamic Optical Link Study Report
assumptions: NRZ optical intensity; effective Tx/Rx first-order poles; left-boundary cascade approximation; warm-up excluded; one-sided Rx ENBW; plateau-conditioned shot Gaussian approximation; finite pattern/context expected error; sample>=threshold decision1; no CDR/jitter/dispersion/RIN/ASE/FEC/WDM dynamics

timing.initialConvention: first warmup plateau; left boundary state; Rx driven by left Tx hold

noise.scope: One-sided input-referred PSD; plateau shot approximation, not continuous/cyclostationary noise or correlated samples

observed.interpretation: Finite synthetic sample errors, not hardware BER measurement

current.probabilityRepresentation: IEEE-754 Gaussian tails may underflow; a displayed 0 is not a verified zero-BER assertion

waveformEvidence.samples: actual generated independent decision samples; never connected as noisy continuous waveform
